abort.different_device: The information entered is from a different Peblar EV charger.
abort.no_serial_number: The discovered Peblar device did not provide a serial number.

reauth_confirm.description:
Reauthenticate with your Peblar EV charger.

To do so, you will need to enter your new password you use to log in to the Peblar EV charger's web interface.

reconfigure.description:
Reconfigure your Peblar EV charger.

This allows you to change the IP address of your Peblar EV charger and the password you use to log in to its web interface.

data_description.host: The hostname or IP address of your Peblar EV charger on your home network.
data_description.password: The same password as you use to log in to the Peblar EV charger's local web interface.

user.description:
Set up your Peblar EV charger to integrate with Home Assistant.

To do so, you will need to get the IP address of your Peblar EV charger and the password you use to log in to its web interface.

Home Assistant will automatically configure your Peblar EV charger for use with Home Assistant.

zeroconf_confirm.description:
Set up your Peblar EV charger {hostname}, on IP address {host}, to integrate with Home Assistant

To do so, you will need the password you use to log in to the Peblar EV charger's web interface.

Home Assistant will automatically configure your Peblar EV charger for use with Home Assistant.

no_autocharge_hardware.message: {charger} has no power line communication hardware, so it cannot use autocharge.
